svg.text: Normal HR75 LA blood PV candidate cards
Blood-volume axis only. Effective/capacity and prime traces are intentionally omitted. X-descent depth, crossing location, and V-loop area are readbacks, not hard adoption by themselves.
Reject visually impossible rows: upward post-MV-opening conduit, vertical fold/kink, or elastance-rise fake V-loop. Compare shape by eye against the Nature-style reservoir/conduit/pumping references.
